name: Pretix
description: Ticket sales and event registration platform for conferences, concerts and other events.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      PRETIX_DATABASE_BACKEND: postgresql
      PRETIX_DATABASE_NAME: pretix
      PRETIX_DATABASE_USER: pretix
      PRETIX_DATABASE_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      PRETIX_REDIS_LOCATION: "redis://{{serviceName}}-redis:6379/0"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      PRETIX_SECRET: {{env.PRETIX_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: pretix
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: pretix
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
